replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heyho Legoche,

After some research, I can say that it's not possible to collect IPs by linking a google sheet.
There is no redirection or anything that could indicate an IP logger.
Maybe your internet provider had some troubles or the signal was troubled.
If you have more evidence, please create another report since I'll deny this one.

Regards Flo/resepignev
